placements.why: The document establishes formal verification gates and deployment controls governing release train progression across staging and production.
placements.title: Formal Quality and Verification Gates Governing Release Progression
placements.frame: What explicit validation standards, review gates, and verification criteria must artifacts satisfy before advancing across environments?

placements.title: Cryptographically Signed Manifests Form a Mandatory Deployment Gate Across Environments
placements.frame: Why are signed release manifests required for deployment progression, and how do verification gates enforce artifact integrity across staging and production?
placements.why: Quinton Fairweather mandates signed release manifests for all Meridian deployments to staging and production in response to prior unsigned artifact incidents, defining concrete gate requirements, scope, and ownership.
